info.title: Task Management System API (Dev)
info.description:
Complete OpenAPI spec for the Task Management System refactor — all implemented backend modules.

## Local database (before Apidog)
1. Run DbUp migrations (`DatabaseMigrator` on `Scripts/Migrations/` — 18 scripts, 000–010 and 012–018).
2. Seed dev user: `./scripts/seed-database.ps1` (creates `TST001` / Integration Test Team; not part of migrations).
3. Start API: `dotnet run --project src/Api/TaskManagementSystem.Api` (default http://localhost:61173).

See **docs/DATABASE.md** for connection strings and seed details.

## Apidog quick start (auto token)
1. Import **openapi/apidog/environment.local-dev.json** → select environment **TMS Local Dev**.
2. Import this spec. Set **bearerAuth** default token to `{{accessToken}}` (Components → Security Schemes → bearerAuth).
3. On **POST /auth/login** and **POST /auth/refresh-token**, add Post-processor **Extract Variable**: JSONPath `$.accessToken` → env var `accessToken` (or use script from `openapi/apidog/scripts/save-access-token.js`).
4. **POST /auth/login** with `{ "code": "{{userCode}}" }` — token is saved automatically; all secured endpoints inherit Bearer auth.

See **openapi/apidog/post-processors.json** for full setup and test scenarios (`auth-bootstrap.json`, `get-queries-timing.json`).

Refresh: **POST /auth/refresh-token** (HttpOnly refreshToken cookie from login).
Logout: **POST /auth/logout** (clears refresh cookie; optional clear-access-token post-processor).

## Error responses
400/404 ProblemDetails include a `code` extension. Validation failures use `code: validation_failed` with an `errors` object (`propertyName` → message array).

## Modules included
- **Auth** — login, refresh, logout, about-me
- **Identity** — RBAC permissions, roles, user role assignment, user admin
- **Organization** — teams and sections CRUD
- **Workflows** — schemas, nodes, task bank, steps
- **Curriculum** — years, projects, terms, subject groups, subjects, units, lessons, learning objectives
- **Sprints** — sprint planning and LO assignment
- **Tickets** — tasks, comments, work time, sprint-scoped lists
- **Notifications** — inbox and read state
- **HR** — leave, holidays, time-off permissions, work from home, forgot clock

Request examples include optional fields where applicable. Replace example IDs and dates with valid values for your environment. Bodyless operations do not require an empty JSON object. For a complete Apidog replacement, import this combined file with Overwrite and Delete (Sync); do not use a module subset for whole-project synchronization.
